title: Pan-Seared Duck Gyoza with Asian Glaze
description: A fusion dish featuring crispy duck gyoza served with a sweet and savory Asian-inspired glaze. Perfect for a dinner party or special occasion.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the duck gyoza to the pan, leaving space between each piece.
Pan-fry the gyoza for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and crispy.
While the gyoza is cooking, combine the vivid honey, dense soy sauce, Japanese sake, and grated ginger in a small saucepan.
Bring the glaze to a simmer over medium heat, stirring constantly.
Once the gyoza is cooked, remove it from the pan and brush the Asian glaze on top.
